decoding.decoder: phase-2 exclusive timeline (bnd.link.frame_labels) then same-speaker gap-fill

crop_policy.usable_frames: track active (p>=theta_act, 0.1 s min turn) and all other 7 channels < theta_act; usable runs < 0.1 s dropped
crop_policy.pieces: usable runs concatenated in time order, cut into k=ceil(L/4) equal pieces (1.5-4 s each when L>=1.5 s); 0.5<=L<1.5 s -> one short piece; L<0.5 s -> no crop (NaN row)
crop_policy.strong_short_band: DECISION 2026-09-25 (pre-DER; PREREG undefined): strong tracks with 1.0<=usable<1.5 s stay strong and are embedded from their single short piece of all usable speech (no padding, no non-usable audio)
crop_policy.valid_length: each crop embedded alone at its true sample length, no padding
crop_policy.track_embedding: duration-weighted mean of L2-normalised crop embeddings, L2-normalised

provenance.rule: Default = FT if Q1 'fine-tuning helps', else ZS. Final configuration = joint mode of the five inner selections of the default system (ties -> simpler).

q1.verdict: no demonstrated benefit over calibrated zero-shot decoding

disclosures: SECOND-LOOK: every phase-3b factor (session length, theta_act < 0.40, refine linker, gap-fill) was motivated by phase-2 OUTER-fold diagnostics; selection used inner folds only.
Any DER of this configuration over all 10 labelled recordings is a DEVELOPMENT number, never held-out.
One training seed; 10 recordings; coarse references (all onsets/durations whole seconds).
Speaker over-counting: the selected ZS system predicted sum |pred-ref| = 192 speakers over the 10 outer recordings (e.g. 68 vs 17 on train_006).
